text:
maria: quick async standup — model onboarding + evals update

What I did: pulled LlamaX-3-small into the serving branch, ran the baseline evals on the spanish promptset, and landed a tiny KV-cache hotfix (PR #4523). Latency looks fine on dev pool (p50 ~ 45ms), but saw a regression on a subset of re-ranking tests.

Blockers: one flakey rerank test keeps failing on long-context examples ( >2048 tokens ). stack shows `KeyError` in kv_cache.lookup for some prefix keys — I added extra null-checks but need someone to eyeball the input serialization. Also need a quick CR on the config tweak I made for continuous batching thresholds.

Today: 1) triage the rerank failures and add a small reproducer; 2) pair with @raj on the KV-key normalization; 3) trigger a canary with the new batching params in staging.

raj: happy to pair at 11:30am PT. I had a similar bug when tokenizer added non-breaking spaces — might be related. send me the reproducer when you have it. :+1:

kevin: pinged for CR on #4523. small change, mostly null guards + a unit. if you can review in next 2hrs i can fold it into the canary.

maria: thanks — added a minimal repro in the thread below (see code block).

maria: ```python
# repro snippet: simulate long prefix with mixed spaces
prefix = "Hola\u00A0mundo " * 180  # NBSP + regular space
input_ids = tokenizer(prefix + " pregunta: ¿Cuál es...", return_tensors='pt').input_ids
# call into kv cache warmup flow
serving.kv_cache.warmup(input_ids)
```

ana: quick note — eval-bot reported a downward drift on the rerank MRR for the spanish-set yesterday (delta -0.6%). could be signal from the model switch or prompt normalization. tagging @eval-bot to post the full diffs.

eval-bot: nightly-evals: LlamaX-3-small (spanish-promptset) — MRR -0.62%, P@1 -0.45%. Regression concentrated in long-prefix cohort (>1500 tokens). See /evals/diffs/1789 for details.

raj: that aligns with the NBSP theory. I can repro locally using the snippet. I'll open a small patch to normalize whitespace before KV lookup.

kevin: reviewed #4523 — left one nit about an assertion message. otherwise LGTM. if you want me to merge and kick canary, say the word.

maria: merging once raj's whitespace patch lands. canary target: staging-us-west-2, 2 pods, 5m ramp.

ci-bot: deploy-scheduler: canary scheduled by kevin -> staging-us-west-2 (2 pods) at 2026-03-17T19:05:00Z.

raj: opened #4524 to normalize NBSPs before key generation. small test added.

ana: will re-run the focused rerank suite after canary. if MRR still dips, we should roll back model variant and run an isolated prompt-normalization eval.

maria: thanks all. blocking help resolved (raj pairing). will post results in this thread and tag folks if canary looks bad.

kevin: if you want an extra pair on canary monitoring i can stand by the dashboard for the first 10m.

maria: appreciate it — pls watch latency and error-rate, i'll watch the rerank metrics. :rocket:
